newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian lev firms to 994-996 per mark, up vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian lev firms to 994-996 per mark, up vs dlr.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev firmed to 994-996 per mark at the opening on Tuesday from 995-997 at Monday's close in thin trade due to traditionally low foreign currency demand at the beginning of the month.
* The lev rose to 1,855-1,858 to the dollar from 1,859-1,863 at Monday's close, tracking firmer morning mark/dollar on global markets.
* The lev has been pegged at 1,000 to the mark as an anchor under an IMF-prescribed currency board system, a fixed exchange rate mechanism introduced on July 1 to restore confidence in the lev.
* Local traders adjust the lev/dollar through the lev/mark and the international mark/dollar cross as the interbank lev/mark may deviate by up to 0.5 percent from the currency board peg.
* Under the system the central bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of marks at 995 levs bid and 1,000 ask. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
